name: strata-terrain-edge
subject: The player walks into the playable edge and stays on ground that has a collider

resources.allowTrivial: The character settles during warmup; grounded must still hold after 25 s pressed against the edge.
Spawn is 91 m from the edge; 80 m proves the walk reached it.
The surveyed hills past the 512 m square are ground out to a 200 m band: the walk climbs at least 20 m onto them. Before they had a collider the player stopped 2 m inside the edge (overshoot -2.2 m).
